mode: new composition using v1 as character and style reference
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished production illustration for a web plugin header, exact 3:1 landscape canvas, approximately 2172 x 724.

Create a NEW composition. The supplied image is ONLY a reference for the two character identities, their Q/chibi proportions, clothing, work roles, and subdued painterly medium. DISCARD its large dark empty left zone and unbalanced layout.

Primary request: a complete, naturally illuminated community discussion duty room filling the ENTIRE panorama. Both whale girls work together at one continuous desk. This must read as a finished illustration from left edge to right edge, not two characters pasted beside a blank panel.

Composition: At left 0–30% show an actual furnished corner of the same room: visible muted blue-gray wooden shelving, neatly stacked folders and books, a softly lit wall and the edge of the shared wooden desktop, several contextual objects. Ambient blue daylight from a small high window or soft room light makes all left-side environment details clearly visible. Keep upper-left details quiet and low contrast for a modest HTML title block overlaid later, but DO NOT create empty negative space, a flat-color text panel, black fog, strong vignette or a dark gradient. Keep the LEFT and RIGHT exposure reasonably balanced. No part of the canvas should be a featureless near-black region. The desk and background forms must visibly connect across the whole width.

BLACK whale girl centered around x=51–55%, BLUE whale girl centered around x=80–84%. Each is a cute approximately 2.5-head-tall chibi with a large round face, tiny torso and short arms. Heads, hair tufts, hands and essential tools fit with at least 8% safe space from top/bottom/side canvas edges. Medium-wide three-quarter desk view with enough space for distinct actions. The leftmost 30% contains environment, not characters.

Black girl identity: long black wavy hair, blue-gray eyes, horizontal dark whale-fin ears, white scalloped wave/lace headband and a compact black-and-ivory work uniform. No monocle. She operates a small keyboard or touchpad at an angled computer workstation, actively organizing simple linked geometric tool cards on screen. No legible screen writing. Her expression is calm and focused. A document tray links her output to her colleague's notes.

Blue girl identity: long navy-blue wavy hair with muted blue-cyan tips, blue-gray eyes, curved ahoge, whale-fin ears, white wave/lace headband with blue side bow, delicate old-gold transparent monocle over HER LEFT eye (viewer-right). Dark navy short cape and jacket, ivory standing collar, small whale-tail gold clasp. She looks down at her OWN clipboard and checks loose discussion sheets on the shared desk. One hand holds clipboard close to her body, paper side facing HER, so viewer sees the plain dark BACK of the board; other hand writes/checks with a small pencil. Small badge uses a tiny speech bubble plus magnifying glass symbol only. Her work clearly differs from operating the computer.

Style and lighting: keep the reference's refined serious, deep yet cute Q-version hand-painted art, cool blue-gray and navy palette, ivory, charcoal and restrained antique gold. Matte painterly surfaces, concentrated gentle expressions, beautiful clear faces, consistent rendering across both characters. Lift the shadows to medium cool blue-gray so furniture remains visible, avoiding gloom. A modest warm desk lamp on the far right gives local highlights only; overall scene remains cool and subdued. Not glossy gacha art. Not a war poster, not a cartoon sticker collage.

No lettering, slogans, title, numbers, logos, watermarks, captions, HUD overlay, frame borders, columns or split panels. No lighthouse, weapons, police imagery, oversized modern gadgets. Prefer tails naturally hidden behind desk; if any tail appears it has a real stalk joining two lateral flukes with a central notch, never a loose fin-shaped ribbon.
Deliver just the complete full-width 3:1 illustration, ready for a small real HTML title at the upper left. Do not copy any words or page controls from references.

review.changes: Full-width furnished duty room with visible left-side bookshelf, window and desk. Black character operates workstation; blue character checks inward-facing clipboard. No intentional black text-safe region.
review.layout: Art fills entire header with proportional cover, no mask. Real HTML copy uses a compact translucent information card; narrow panels hide scene.
review.deviations: Generated 2169×725 is approximately 3:1, with negligible edge crop at exact 3:1 display.
